test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_trailing_key (match_id UInt64, account_id UInt32, v UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (match_id, account_id) SETTINGS index_granularity = 64, index_granularity_bytes = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_trailing_key SELECT number, cityHash64(number) % 2000000, cityHash64(number, 1) % 1000 FROM numbers_mt(20000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 8
test.query: EXPLAIN indexes = 1 SELECT count() FROM t_trailing_key WHERE account_id = 12345
SELECT sum(v) FROM t_trailing_key WHERE account_id IN (12345, 54321, 111111) SETTINGS max_threads = 8
EXPLAIN indexes = 1 SELECT count() FROM t_trailing_key WHERE account_id = 12345 AND match_id > 1000
